name: Notice of Nurse Refusal to Administer Medication
description: When the nurse refuses to give a medication judged inappropriate or too high a dose, the nurse immediately contacts the family, administrators and prescriber.
recipient: Parent, principal, Director of Special Education, licensed prescriber, and (if needed) District consulting physician
quote: In this situation, the nurse will immediately contact the parent, principal, Director of Special Education, the student's licensed prescriber and, where necessary, the district's consulting physician.
